description: Companion -> host event asking the host to interrupt the current run (Q1-Q10 decision, transcribed 2026-11-01). reason is optional. Interrupting does not change the stream contract: the host still ends the run with exactly one result record. Unknown fields are allowed (v1 ignore-unknown rule).

reason.description: Optional free-text reason for the interrupt, for logging and display; the host must not depend on its values.

uuid.description: Fresh UUID v4 per message in real runs. Type is string only: no format is enforced because the shipped fixtures use the placeholder string "<uuid>", which is not a valid UUID.

v.description: Contract version, currently 1. The companion events are additive in v1, so v stays 1 (Q1-Q10 decision: no version bump).

title: companion-ws v1 companion_interrupt event (APP-2 M1)
